structures.derivation: Z-Anatomy's cortex (BodyParts3D: its gyrus and sulcus patches, remade as closed surfaces about 0.25 mm outside them, the temporal lobe apart from the rest), by the lobe of each patch's Z-Anatomy collection; where it reached into this model's bone, pushed 1 mm inside the cranial cavity. Its shapes for the surgical views (the right Sylvian fissure opened, the frontal lobe lifted along the pterional and the lateral supraorbital corridors, the right hemisphere held off the falx) are Skull base v3's rules, run in this model's own cranial cavity (skullbase_v1_brain.py): shapes, not simulations of the tissue. In the Kawase view held up off the middle fossa floor (extradurally, with its dura) by up to 14 mm over the petrous apex (skullbase_v3.py: lift_temporal_lobe; illustrative): a shape, not a simulation.
